Holland NL Scholarship 2025-2026 in the Netherlands: Complete Guide for International Students - Scholarships Future Skip to content The Holland NL Scholarship 2025-2026 offers an exciting opportunity for international students from non-European Economic Area (EEA) countries to study in the Netherlands. Funded by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture, and Science, this scholarship supports talented students pursuing bachelor’s or master’s degree programs at participating Dutch institutions. This blog provides a comprehensive overview of the scholarship, including its benefits, eligibility, application process, and tips for success. Basic Information and Application Deadline The NL Scholarship is a partial scholarship providing a financial grant of €5,000 (approximately USD 5,420) awarded in the first year of study. It is designed for non-EEA international students who enroll in full-time bachelor’s or master’s programs at Dutch research universities or universities of applied sciences. Application Deadline: Varies by institution, with common deadlines on 1 February 2026 and 1 May 2026 for different universities. Applicants should check the official website of their chosen university for the exact deadline. Some universities open applications starting 1 November 2025. Participating Universities and Institutions 1. Holland NL Scholarship Benefits A one-time grant of €5,000 (~USD 5,420) disbursed in the first year to support tuition fees or living expenses Access to world-class education in the Netherlands Opportunity to study at internationally recognized Dutch universities Enhance your academic profile and global career prospects Benefits Not Included The scholarship does not cover full tuition fees It does not cover travel costs to and from the Netherlands Monthly living expenses, insurance, and other personal costs are not included No additional financial support beyond the one-time €5,000 grant Eligibility Criteria for the Holland NL Scholarship To qualify, applicants must: Must be a non-EEA (non-European Economic Area) national Applying for a full-time bachelor’s or master’s program Applying to a participating Dutch higher education institution Meet the specific admission requirements of your chosen institution Do not already hold a degree from a Dutch institution Have an excellent academic record and demonstrate strong motivation Code of conduct bankruptcy, insolvency or winding-up procedures; breach of obligations relating to the payment of taxes or social security contributions; conduct related to a criminal organisation; money laundering or terrorist financing; terrorist offenses or offenses linked to terrorist activities; irregularity; creating a shell company; being a shell company. Required Documents for the Application Applicants typically need to submit: Completed application form (available on the university website) Letter of motivation (max 500 words) highlighting academic achievements and extracurricular activities Valid passport or national ID Academic transcripts and diplomas Proof of English proficiency (IELTS, TOEFL, etc.) if required by the institution Curriculum Vitae (CV) Any additional documents requested by the specific university Step-by-Step Holland NL Scholarship Application Process Choose a program and university: Explore the eligible programs and universities participating in the NL Scholarship. Check admission requirements: Verify specific entry criteria and application deadlines on the institution’s official website. Apply for admission: Submit your application for your chosen course through the university’s online portal. Indicate scholarship application: Mark your interest in the NL Scholarship during your application and upload the motivation letter. Prepare required documents: Gather all necessary documents as specified by the university. Submit scholarship application: Complete the scholarship application through the university portal before the deadline. Wait for notification: Universities conduct the selection process and notify successful candidates, usually within weeks after the deadline. Tips for a Successful Application Start your application early to avoid last-minute issues Carefully read and fulfill all the scholarship and admission requirements Write a compelling and clear motivation letter emphasizing your academic strengths and goals Collect and organize all documents neatly and ensure translations if needed Follow up politely with the university’s scholarship office if you have questions or need clarification Monthly Living Expenses for International Students in the Netherlands (in USD) Accommodation: $600 – $1,200 Food and groceries: $300 – $400 Public transport: $80 – $110 Health insurance: $100 – $150 Miscellaneous (clothing, entertainment, study materials): $150 – $200 Average monthly living cost: $1,230 – $2,060 Why Choose the NL Scholarship? Five Key Reasons Financial Support: Receive €5,000 to offset tuition fees or living costs. Study in a Global Hub: The Netherlands is renowned for high-quality education and international environment. Wide Range of Programs: Study diverse fields at respected universities tailored for global students. Boost Career Prospects: Dutch degrees are well-regarded worldwide, enhancing job and further study opportunities. Cultural Experience: Live in a vibrant, inclusive country offering quality of life, travel opportunities, and personal growth. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q: Is the NL Scholarship renewable? A: No, it is a one-time grant awarded for the first year only. Q: Can I combine the NL Scholarship with other funding? A: It depends on the university policies; check the specific institution’s guidelines. Q: Does the scholarship cover travel expenses? A: No, travel and insurance costs are not included. Q: What if I miss the application deadline? A: Applications are strictly bound by deadlines; late submissions are generally not accepted. Q: Can I apply if I have a degree from the Netherlands? A: No, previous Dutch degree holders are not eligible. Application Period: Opens: 1 November 2025 Deadline: Varies by institution — check your chosen university’s website Official Link: This guide aims to empower international students with the necessary information to successfully apply for the Holland NL Scholarship 2025-2026 and study in the Netherlands.
